description: This file defines the class DataElementFile, which is a C++ class representing a file data element within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes member functions for managing file operations such as opening, closing, unlinking, destroying, and accessing file properties. The class inherits from DataElement and interacts with other classes like File, FileSystem, and Portability.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: Represents a file data element with methods for file management, including opening, closing, unlinking, destroying, and property access within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the file.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open and valid.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying File object.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the file.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Returns the user ID for a given username.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Returns the group ID for a given group name.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Returns permission bits for a given mode.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the file content or metadata.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Handles reallocation of the file's memory.

methods.name: OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Opens a memory-mapped file with a required size.
